findings.subjectClaim: The dispatch pins "Speaker is sarif leftover-join.v6", and the subject's own authorityClaim, purpose, doesNot and proposedLaterWork all speak in that voice. But in 8 of the 11 obligation rows and 2 basedOn roles, the closing disclaimer sentence has sarif leftover-join.v5 — the frozen, unrecorded, REJECTED predecessor — as its grammatical subject.
findings.liveState: sarif leftover-join.v5 carries 30 distinct "sarif leftover-join.v5 does not / is not …" sentences, where every one was a correct first-person disclaimer because v5 was the speaker. The subject re-voices 20 of them to sarif leftover-join.v6 and leaves 10 unconverted. The document therefore holds 37 "sarif leftover-join.v6" tokens and 25 "sarif leftover-join.v5" tokens, of which these 10 sit in disclaimer position rather than historical position.
findings.refutation:
This is not a stylistic preference, and it is not cured by the sentences being true of v5's bytes. Three things establish the defect from the bytes alone.

(1) The subject's own converted rows prove the intended pattern. OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX closes "sarif leftover-join.v6 does not invent those remaining bytes, does not invent a D-002 platform list, and does not mint a D9 code"; OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX and OBL-G26 close the same way. The author was placing a speaker-voiced disclaimer at the foot of each obligation reason and completed that pass on 3 rows out of 11. The 10 residues are an incomplete string-patch of the predecessor, not a deliberate historical framing — none of them carries any historical marker ("measured", "landed at", "as of"), which is how the corpus writes genuine predecessor history.

(2) The house norm under the current discipline is the opposite. The four sibling joins accepted and recorded at D-321 through D-324 were scanned for predecessor tokens in disclaimer position: g19 leftover-join.v6 has 0 (its 12 v5 tokens are all historical), g20 leftover-join.v9 has 0, g30 leftover-join.v8 has 0, and g21 leftover-join.v14 has exactly 1 — "g21 leftover-join.v13 does not reopen G21LJ-V10-SF1" — which is a statement of what the predecessor did about a named prior finding, i.e. history, not a live disclaimer. Predecessor tokens are plentiful in all four; predecessor-voiced *disclaimers* are absent. The subject carries 10.

(3) The consequence is load-bearing, because these are the rows where the disclaimer is the only place the constraint appears at obligation level. OBL-PREVIEW-NOT-ADVERTISED, OBL-G17, OBL-FC-APPLIC, OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM, OBL-FC-OUTFAIL, OBL-INACTIVE-DR006 and OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY each end by disclaiming SARIF advertisement, G17 resurrection, D9 minting, RunId/Finding recipes, or advisory discharge — and each now disclaims them on behalf of an artifact the dispatch states "stays unrecorded". If sarif leftover-join.v6 is recorded as the DR-122 leftover remasurement, the recorded row-level reasons assert the standing of a rejected predecessor instead of the recorded artifact, and a reader lifting any one reason out of the file gets a disclaimer attached to the wrong version. The top-level authorityClaim does carry the v6-voiced equivalents, so nothing here is contradicted elsewhere in the document — but a remasurement whose function is to speak currently cannot leave its majority of obligation rows speaking as the version it supersedes.
findings.notCuredBy: The prompt's attack-list item "an unstemmed leftover-join.vN prose token, including a bare 'at v2'" does not reach this: all 10 tokens are fully family-stemmed, and that attack is separately clean. Codex's ACCEPT 0/0 on sarif leftover-join.v5 does not cure it either — under v5 these sentences were correct, and the defect is created by the transformation, not inherited as a flaw. The v5 Stage A Claude review's positive verification that no deictic self-naming form occurs remains true of the subject; this is the adjacent defect the deixis rule exists to prevent, reached by an explicit predecessor name rather than by "This join".
findings.repairShape: In a successor, re-voice all 10 sentences to sarif leftover-join.v6, matching the pattern already used in OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX, OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX and OBL-G26. Where a statement about the predecessor is genuinely wanted, write it as history with an explicit marker ("sarif leftover-join.v5 measured …"), not as a bare present-tense disclaimer. This repair touches wording only: it requires no new digest, no new identifier, no edit to sarif leftover-join.v5, sarif leftover-join.v4, either occupancy, either golden, file 08 or COORD, and it does not open Class A, close leftover-design, or SATISFY DR-122 or DR-117.

decision.rule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX.
decision.reason: The measurement work is correct and the custody discipline is exact: 72 recomputed digests with zero mismatches, HEAD triple-matched, five cited commits resolved, last-heading custody clean, and every one of the sixteen attacks in the dispatch defeated on the bytes. All three sarif leftover-join.v5 Stage A Claude findings genuinely landed — the G26 currency repair is thorough, the D-002 platform route now quotes the source the recorded goldens quote and its ORDERED-EQUAL cross-check recomputes true, and the stemming pass is complete. The candidate fails on speaker identity instead. Ten disclaimer sentences across 8 of the 11 obligations and 2 basedOn roles were carried from the predecessor without re-voicing, so the majority of the document's row-level obligation reasons disclaim on behalf of sarif leftover-join.v5 — a frozen, rejected, unrecorded artifact — while the dispatch pins sarif leftover-join.v6 as the speaker and the subject's own three converted rows show the pattern that was intended.
decision.consequenceIfRecordedAsIs: The recorded DR-122 leftover remasurement would carry seven obligation rows whose only disclaimer of SARIF advertisement, G17 resurrection, D9 minting, RunId/Finding recipes and advisory discharge is attached to the superseded version rather than to the recorded one. Any reason lifted out of the file for a later decision record would carry the wrong version's standing.
decision.pathToAccept: Re-voice the ten sentences to sarif leftover-join.v6 in a successor, matching the pattern already present in OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX, OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX and OBL-G26. Nothing else in the candidate needs to change: no digest, no identifier, no edit to any frozen artifact, file 08 or COORD, and no opening of Class A or closing of leftover-design.
